findings.text: the wait loop yields False and returns once seat_names_a_live_foreign_producer is false, so a foreign holder whose stream has gone stale while its seat lock is still held (a hung producer) takes the pre-change exit path: the caller yields a watcher-live row and returns, the unit exits and systemd restarts it, which is the cycling the node exists to stop for that sub-case; the plan's 'taking the seat when that producer's stream goes stale' is only reached when the holder has also released the lock, as the test arranges.

baseline_suite and after_suite are prose rather than the armed-JSON shape the manifest key requests, so a reader that derives the added-failure count from them (reckon/crew/review.py:2140 annotate_review_of_run) finds no log_path and records added_failure_count as unmeasured (None) rather than the 0 the cited gate logs support.
